Executive Order 5543. January 30, 1931
Executive Order
Power- Site Restoration No, 459
Idaho
So much of Executive order of June 27, 1912, creating Power-Site Reserve
No. 283, as affects the lands hereinafter described is hereby revoked:
Boise Meridian
T. 9S., R. 14 E., sec. 11, lot 3.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
January 30, 1931.
[No. 5543]
